summary: Phase 12 full-stack testing — Live NHL Scoring + 86-team demo seed. 14/14 backend pytest tests passed. Frontend: /live page renders with LIVE SCORING heading, 10 FINAL NHL games (DET/TBL, NYR/FLA, CAR/PHI, DAL/TOR, MIN/STL, SJS/NSH, BUF/CHI, COL/EDM, LAK/SEA, WPG/VGK) with real scores. Refresh Scores button fires /api/live-scoring/refresh and timestamp updates (3:27:25 AM -> 3:28:02 AM). League dropdown switch from Ice Kings -> Frozen Dynasty triggers /api/live-scoring/league/{id} (200). Top Team Roster tab shows Checkmate Chiefs (Frozen Dynasty's top team) with 69.50 total FPTS; Jack Eichel 15.00, Quinton Byfield 13.00, etc. Dashboard LiveScoringWidget shows '10 NHL games for 2026-04-13 · 400 players tracked'. Sidebar has 'Live Scoring' Radio link between Roster and Standings. All 5 demo leagues full at max capacity (12+14+16+12+32=86). 1038 players unchanged.

minor.issue: league_id is validated via _safe_object_id but teams are queried with the raw string league_id (teams.league_id is stored as string, not ObjectId). Works correctly today because seed stores strings, but the ObjectId validation is effectively only used for the 400-on-malformed check. Not a bug.

Player aggregate aggregates 'wins' but not 'losses' or 'shutouts' into the top-level row; goalie W/L detail is dropped. If the leaderboard is later used for goalie decision scoring in the UI, UI would need that data. Not blocking this phase.
Unauthenticated admin-only check is missing — any logged-in user can trigger a fresh NHL API poll. Could be abused as a rate-limit shield. Consider gating to commissioner/admin or adding a cooldown.

issues: Cards all show 'FINAL' state badge but the badge styling is identical to a live 'LIVE' badge would be — consider colour-coding (green for FINAL, red pulse for LIVE/CRIT) to better convey real-time state at a glance.
Saves column shows '-' for skaters which is fine, but the 'GAMES' column always shows 1 in today's sample because only one date has data. Not a bug — cosmetic expectation.

action_items: Consider rate-limiting or admin-gating POST /api/live-scoring/refresh (currently any auth user can hammer the NHL API).
Continue the pending server.py router split recommended in iteration_11 — file is now at 3485 lines with the new live-scoring endpoints added inline.
Optional UX polish: colour-code the game-state pill (FINAL vs LIVE vs CRIT) on LiveScoringPage.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: live_scoring_worker._flatten_boxscore uses `side.replace('Team','Team')` which is a no-op — clearly a copy-paste typo; `team_abbrev` resolves correctly only because bx.get('homeTeam')/'awayTeam' keys match the loop key directly. Harmless but misleading — simplify to `bx.get(side, {}).get('abbrev')`.

_recompute_team_live_totals pulls ALL players with live_stats (up to 10,000) on every poll cycle (every 60s) and then walks every team. O(N*M) per tick. At current scale (1038 players, 86 teams) this is fine, but if the league count grows, aggregate this in MongoDB with an $lookup pipeline instead.

run_once does not bound the number of boxscore fetches — on a big NHL night (16 games) that's 16 sequential HTTP calls while holding the worker. Consider asyncio.gather over a thread pool since nhlpy is sync.
server.py is now 3485 lines — router split still deferred. Live-scoring block (lines 893-992) would cleanly move into /app/backend/routers/live_scoring.py.
POST /api/live-scoring/refresh has no auth role check — any authenticated user can force a poll. Low risk inside this app but surfaces NHL API quota to public users.
LiveScoringPage league dropdown currently hits the server on every change with no debounce; fine for click-driven changes but if switched to a multi-select it would need throttling.
